    Apache Pulsar support for Spring 3.0.0-M1-SNAPSHOT API

    This document is the API specification for the Apache Pulsar support for Spring project.
    Packages
    Package
    Description
    org.apache.pulsar.spring
    Package containing the classes of Apache Pulsar support for Spring.
    org.apache.pulsar.spring.annotation
    Package containing annotations used by the framework.
    org.apache.pulsar.spring.aot
    Package containing AOT runtime hints used by the framework.
    org.apache.pulsar.spring.boot.autoconfigure
    Auto-configuration for Apache Pulsar support for Spring.
    org.apache.pulsar.spring.cache.provider
    Package containing the cache provider abstraction for Pulsar.
    org.apache.pulsar.spring.cache.provider.caffeine
    Package containing components to support Pulsar Caffeine cache provider.
    org.apache.pulsar.spring.cloud.stream.binder
    Package containing Spring Cloud Stream binder classes for Apache Pulsar.
    org.apache.pulsar.spring.cloud.stream.binder.config
     
    org.apache.pulsar.spring.cloud.stream.binder.properties
    Package containing Spring Cloud Stream binder properties classes for Apache Pulsar.
    org.apache.pulsar.spring.cloud.stream.binder.provisioning
    Package containing Spring Cloud Stream binder provisioning classes for Apache Pulsar.
    org.apache.pulsar.spring.config
    Package containing Spring configuration classes for the framework.
    org.apache.pulsar.spring.core
    Package containing the core components of the framework.
    org.apache.pulsar.spring.event
    Package containing events produced by the framework.
    org.apache.pulsar.spring.function
    Package containing support for Pulsar Functions and Pulsar IO Connectors.
    org.apache.pulsar.spring.listener
    Package containing listener components for receiving Pulsar messages.
    org.apache.pulsar.spring.listener.adapter
    Package containing components for adapting Pulsar messages to message listeners.
    org.apache.pulsar.spring.observation
    Package containing components that provide support for the Observation API.
    org.apache.pulsar.spring.reader
    Package containing components to support Pulsar reader functionality.
    org.apache.pulsar.spring.support
    Package containing general support components.
    org.apache.pulsar.spring.support.converter
    Package containing message converters.
    org.apache.pulsar.spring.support.header
    Package containing components to support Pulsar header functionality.
    org.apache.pulsar.spring.support.internal.logging
    Package containing components to support Pulsar internal logging functionality.
    org.apache.pulsar.spring.transaction
    Provides classes related to transactions.
